brand_notes: Kanta is Focal's mid range (between Aria and Sopra); N°1 is the only standmount. Polymer baffle, beryllium IAL3 tweeter, flax woofer. US price $5,999 (2019) -> $8,598 at TMR 2026 (mfr-focal-kanta-n1). Claimed 88 dB not confirmed (86.5 NRC, 87.2-87.7 HFN). Upscale Audio shows all finishes sold out (mfr-focal-kanta-n1).
takeaways: Measured sensitivity 86.5 (NRC) to 87.7 dB (HFN) vs 88 dB claimed.
Impedance minimum 3.8 Ω @ 201 Hz (HFN) with EPDR to 2.0 Ω: effectively a 4 Ω load despite 8 Ω rating.
LW within ~±2.3 dB (NRC graph-read) with presence dip; HFN bass f6 48 Hz.
THD 0.9% @100 Hz at 90 dB/1 m (HFN); NRC ~1.3% at ~96 dB/1 m.
Critics praise clean, open sound and imaging; limited bass depth/loud-level headroom.
One US retailer shows sold out; kept current on TMR listing.
conflicts: min impedance 3.8 Ω (HFN) vs ~4.5 Ω (NRC graph)
